chunks: Of what substance did He create him?
ai.seo_question: What substance was man created from according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question underscores the paradox of human arrogance, where the creator of humble clay is often forgotten by those who claim superiority. It serves as a foundational reminder of *tawhid* in creation, linking the physical origin of man to his spiritual accountability before God.
